title: Santa's Workshop 12.5" Gingerbread LED Tree

comparisons.notes: Product page title '12.5 Inch Gingerbread LED Tree', model 90650, same description (5.5x5.5x13.5 in., 3 AAA batteries). Listed at sale $69.86 with free shipping, no out-of-stock notice.

writeup: Woot has the Santa's Workshop 12.5" Gingerbread LED Tree, new, for $31.99. Bed Bath & Beyond sells the same model 90650 for $69.86, so this is about 54% below other stores. It's a hand-painted resin tree, 13.5 inches tall, that lights up on 3 AAA batteries, and Woot caps it at 3 per customer.
amazon_match_notes: Woot offer data lists Asin B09298HH5Z; checker verified the exact ASIN listing.
